appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Customize how the app looks

appearance.density_hint: Controls how much spacing the app uses. Compact fits more on screen; Cozy gives everything more room to breathe.

appearance.preview_muted_text: Muted description text with secondary content

appearance.ambient_hint: Phase chip in the title bar that updates with your local clock — dawn, day, dusk, night.

engine.title: Engine

engine.tuning_reason_no_qualified_challenger: No alternative model has reached the {floor}-run evidence floor in {category} yet.
engine.tuning_reason_saving_below_threshold: Cheaper options exist in {category}, but the saving is below the threshold I require before proposing a switch.

engine.tuning_reason_already_routed: {category} already routes to the best-evidenced model.

engine.tuning_budget_lower: Lower the monthly ceiling ${current} → ${proposed} — spend ${observed} runs far below it

limits.title: Limits
limits.subtitle: Parallel-execution cap and monthly cost ceiling
limits.description: Set a monthly USD ceiling on your Personas spend. Stage 1 (this build) is informational — it shows progress and warnings but does not block runs. Stage 2 will enforce the ceiling at execution-dispatch time.
limits.concurrency_hint: How many personas can run at the same time. Extra runs wait in a queue and start automatically as slots free up. Changes apply immediately — no restart needed.
limits.concurrency_queued_note: Runs beyond this limit are queued and promoted by priority, then arrival order, as running ones finish.
limits.ceiling_hint: Combined cost across all personas, refreshed when you reopen this tab. Set to 0 to disable the ceiling.
limits.over_budget: You have exceeded your monthly ceiling. Stage 2 will block new executions when this happens; for now, treat this as a warning.
limits.approaching_budget: You are approaching your monthly ceiling. Consider reviewing recent runs.
limits.no_ceiling_hint: No ceiling is set. Enter a USD amount above to start tracking against a budget.
limits.stage1_note: Stage 1: informational only. Stage 2 will gate execution dispatch when the ceiling is crossed.

history.title: Settings History
history.subtitle: Audit log of changes made to settings
history.description: Append-only record of who changed which setting and when. Use this to trace back surprising behavior or coordinate audit reviews. Every user-facing settings change is recorded here — API keys, engine, limits, retention, autonomy, notifications and more; secret values are redacted, and internal engine bookkeeping is excluded.
history.showing_max: Showing the most recent 100 entries — older history is still in the database.
history.empty: No settings changes recorded yet. Mutations made from here on will appear in this list.
history.empty_filtered: No entries match the current category filter.

api_keys.delete_tooltip: Remove this key from the database permanently.
api_keys.field_name_hint: Short label so you remember which client uses it. Visible only to you.
api_keys.scope_build_desc: Drive a persona build session: start, answer questions, test, promote.
api_keys.scope_read_desc: List personas, fetch persona detail, read execution history.

api_keys.execute_pick_hint: Choose which agents this key may run

quality_gates.title: Quality Gates
quality_gates.description: Quality gates filter AI-generated memories and reviews during execution dispatch. Patterns are matched as substrings against the combined title and content of each submission. When a pattern matches, the configured action is applied. These rules prevent operational noise (credential errors, stack traces, empty workspace reports) from polluting your knowledge base.
quality_gates.memory_filters_desc: Applied to AgentMemory submissions. Blocks operational failures and credential leaks from being stored as persona memories.
quality_gates.review_filters_desc: Applied to ManualReview submissions. Filters infrastructure errors so only genuine business decisions reach the review queue.
quality_gates.rules_hint: Rules are loaded from the database on each dispatch. Changes take effect immediately.
